comment: Manual review (ADR-042) of every citation the automatic check (hisn-verify) could not confirm. Owner decision 2026-10-16: no religious reviewer is available, so the references are checked against an independent copy of the six books instead. Each verdict was made by reading the cited hadith in fawazahmed0/hadith-api (pinned extract: content/sources/verification/hadith-cited.json; the full books were searched for the right numbers). EVIDENCE = the hadith is the evidence or the virtue of the dhikr, not its wording; EDITION = the same hadith, numbered differently in the independent copy; WRONG_NUMBER = the number in the book points to another hadith, the right one is given; SECONDARY = a side remark of the footnote, not the dhikr's source; COPY_GAP = the independent copy has no text for that number (the dhikr is confirmed by its other citations). The build fails if a citation the check cannot confirm has no verdict here, or if a verdict here no longer applies.
